status_detail: Meta's official Altoona fact sheet says the Altoona Data Center broke ground in 2013, is part of Meta's global infrastructure, and supports 400+ operational jobs; the City of Altoona says Meta will have over 5 million square feet of data center space once completed. Capacity value is from US Data Center Map tracker.
notes: Official sources confirm campus, investment, jobs, and scale; tracker gives 1,400 MW and operational status.

status_detail: Turner Construction describes Buildings 1 and 2 as the first of eight data halls for a new Central Iowa campus adjacent to the Altoona Data Center Campus; client is confidential in the published project page.

status_detail: Tract says the 468-acre Altoona site is owned and in development, located in the Des Moines data center region, with by-right data center zoning and utility studies supporting 1,000 MW capacity.

notes: Status set construction because official/news sources describe 2025 construction/top-out with expected completion after a 24-month build.

status_detail: Weitz says the 60,000-square-foot, 5 MW Des Moines data center started in summer 2023 and completed in summer 2024; Salas O'Brien/Epsten project pages describe a roughly 60,000-square-foot state-of-the-art data center in Des Moines with LEED consulting/certification work.
notes: Spelling appears as both Thornton and Thorton in source ecosystem; location listed as Des Moines, IA.

status_detail: Cologix official page lists DSM1 at 606 Walnut Street in downtown Des Moines; Cologix acquisition/news materials describe the facility as 4,000 square feet and 600 kW with expansion potential.
notes: Cologix acquired two Iowa data centers in 2024; DSM1 is the Polk County/Des Moines site while DSM2 is in Cedar Falls outside Polk County.

project_name: US Signal IA01 Des Moines Data Center
status_detail: US Signal official page lists IA01 Des Moines Data Center at 390 N Alices Road, Waukee, with colocation/cloud services; Baxtel says the site is a former OneNeck facility acquired in 2024, built in 2009, with 20,000 square feet and 1,600 kW critical load.

notes: Official source confirms operator/service and Des Moines base but does not publicly disclose the secure facility location; capacity/county placement uses tracker data.
